title: GuardPolicy decision
description: The outcome of deciding one event against a policy, with every rule that was considered. Shared by hol-guard policy check, hol-guard policy test and the Policy Studio Explain panel.

effect.description: allow or block when a rule decided; default when no rule matched and the policy defaults apply. When more rows matched than the runtime reads, the effect is block and ruleId is null.

ruleId.description: The rule that decided, or null for default and for a match-limit block.

ambiguous.description: True when another rule ties with the deciding rule on effect and specificity.

matchLimitExceeded.description: True when more than 256 rows matched; the runtime then blocks without naming a rule.

candidates.description: One entry per compiled rule row, in document order.

action.description: Additive. For a command check, the strongest action a matching command rule asked for, including warn and review, which have no allow or block effect.

document.description: Additive. The policy the decision was made against.

reason.description: The first field that failed for unmatched rows, or why a matching row lost. null for the selected row.
